dose_adult.note: Doses acima de 40 mg/dia não são recomendadas pelo risco de prolongamento do QT (seção 2.1). Máximo de 20 mg/dia para pessoas com mais de 60 anos, com insuficiência hepática, metabolizadores lentos da CYP2C19 ou em uso de inibidor da CYP2C19 (seções 2.3 e 2.4).

cite.quote: Administer CELEXA once daily, with or without food, at an initial dosage of 20 mg once daily, with an increase to a maximum dosage of 40 mg once daily at an interval of no less than one week.
cite.note: Seção 2.3: "The maximum recommended dosage of CELEXA for patients who are greater than 60 years of age, patients with hepatic impairment, and for CYP2C19 poor metabolizers is 20 mg once daily"

facts.note: Seção 4 contraindica pimozida "because of risk of QT prolongation". A seção 5.2 manda evitar com outros fármacos que prolongam o QTc e em QT longo congênito, bradicardia, hipocalemia/hipomagnesemia, IAM recente e insuficiência cardíaca descompensada.

cite.locator: seção 5.2 QT-Prolongation and Torsade de Pointes
cite.quote: CELEXA causes dose-dependent QTc prolongation an ECG abnormality that has been associated with Torsade de Pointes (TdP), ventricular tachycardia, and sudden death, all of which have been observed in postmarketing reports for citalopram

facts.note: Seção 4 (Contraindications): "taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs (including MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue) because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome"

cite.quote: SSRIs, including CELEXA, can precipitate serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition.
Drugs that interfere with serotonin reuptake inhibition, including CELEXA, increase the risk of bleeding events.

cite.locator: seção 5.5 Activation of Mania or Hypomania
cite.quote: In patients with bipolar disorder, treating a depressive episode with CELEXA or another antidepressant may precipitate a mixed/manic episode.

Adverse reactions after discontinuation of serotonergic antidepressants, particularly after abrupt discontinuation, include: nausea, sweating, dysphoric mood, irritability, agitation, dizziness, sensory disturbances (e.g., paresthesia, such as electric shock sensations), tremor, anxiety, confusion, headache, lethargy, emotional lability, insomnia, hypomania, tinnitus, and seizures.
CELEXA should be prescribed with caution in patients with a seizure disorder.

The pupillary dilation that occurs following use of many antidepressant drugs, including CELEXA, may trigger an angle closure attack in a patient with anatomically narrow angles who does not have a patent iridectomy.
Hyponatremia may occur as a result of treatment with SSRIs, including CELEXA.
Use of SSRIs, including CELEXA, may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction

There are risks of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) (see Data) and/or poor neonatal adaptation with exposure to selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), including CELEXA, during pregnancy
There are reports of breastfed infants exposed to citalopram experiencing irritability, restlessness, excessive somnolence, decreased feeding, and weight loss

CELEXA is contraindicated in patients: taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs (including MAOIs such as linezolid or intravenous methylene blue) because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome

schedule.text: Bula: acompanhar de perto sobretudo nos primeiros meses e a cada mudança de dose. NICE (depressão, 18 a 25 anos ou risco aumentado de suicídio): reavaliar 1 semana após iniciar ou aumentar a dose e, depois, quantas vezes for preciso, sem passar de 4 semanas após o início.

cites.locator: seção 5.1 Suicidal Thoughts and Behavior in Adolescents and Young Adults
cites.quote: Monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening and emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors, especially during the initial few months of drug therapy and at times of dosage changes.
When prescribing antidepressant medication for people with depression who are aged 18 to 25 years or are thought to be at increased risk of suicide:
review them 1 week after starting the antidepressant medication or increasing the dose for suicidality
review them again after this as often as needed, but no later than 4 weeks after the appointment at which the antidepressant was started

monitoring.note: Para quem tem as condições cardíacas listadas na seção 5.2 ou usa outros fármacos que prolongam o QTc. A mesma seção pede potássio e magnésio basais e periódicos em quem tem risco de distúrbio eletrolítico.

cite.locator: seção 5.2 QT-Prolongation and Torsade de Pointes
cite.quote: ECG monitoring is recommended in patients for whom CELEXA use is not recommended unless the benefits clearly outweigh the risks for a particular patient

titration.steps: Início: 20 mg 1x/dia; pode subir para o máximo de 40 mg 1x/dia após no mínimo 1 semana. Acima de 40 mg/dia não é recomendado (prolongamento do QT). Máximo de 20 mg/dia acima de 60 anos, na insuficiência hepática, em metabolizadores lentos da CYP2C19 e com inibidor da CYP2C19.

cites.quote: Administer CELEXA once daily, with or without food, at an initial dosage of 20 mg once daily, with an increase to a maximum dosage of 40 mg once daily at an interval of no less than one week. Dosages above 40 mg once daily are not recommended due to the risk of QT prolongation

cites.locator: seção 2.3 Recommended Dosage for Specific Populations
cites.quote: The maximum recommended dosage of CELEXA for patients who are greater than 60 years of age, patients with hepatic impairment, and for CYP2C19 poor metabolizers is 20 mg once daily

cites.locator: seção 2.4 Dosage Modifications with Concomitant Use of CYP2C19 Inhibitors
cites.quote: The maximum recommended dosage of CELEXA when used concomitantly with a CYP2C19 inhibitor is 20 mg once daily

titration.steps: Bula: reduzir a dose gradualmente, em vez de parar de forma abrupta, sempre que possível. NICE: reduzir até zero em etapas de uma fração da dose anterior (ex.: 50%), com reduções menores (ex.: 25%) nas doses baixas, esperando 1 a 2 semanas entre as etapas; meia-vida curta pede retirada mais lenta.
titration.note: Esquema geral da NICE para antidepressivos. Com sintomas de retirada mais intensos, considerar voltar à dose anterior e depois reduzir mais devagar, em passos menores.

cites.quote: Gradually reduce the dosage rather than stopping CELEXA abruptly whenever possible.

slowly reduce the dose to zero in a step-wise fashion, at each step prescribing a proportion of the previous dose (for example, 50% of previous dose) consider using smaller reductions (for example, 25%) as the dose becomes lower

take into account the pharmacokinetic profile (for example, the half-life of the medication as antidepressants with a short half-life will need to be tapered more slowly) and the duration of treatment
allow 1 to 2 weeks to evaluate the effects of dose reduction before considering further dose reductions.

If a person has more severe withdrawal symptoms, consider restarting the original antidepressant medication at the previous dose, and then attempt dose reduction at a slower rate with smaller decrements after symptoms have resolved.

cite.quote: The most common adverse reaction that occurred in CELEXA-treated patients with an incidence of 5% or greater and at least twice the incidence in placebo patients was ejaculation disorder (primarily ejaculatory delay) in male patients

common_effects.note: É a única reação no critério da bula (≥5% e o dobro do placebo), só em homens. Na Tabela 3 (TDM), náusea, boca seca e sonolência são mais frequentes, mas não chegam ao dobro do placebo.
